proposals.name: Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA / AMHE) Enthusiasts
proposals.buyer_persona: Adult historical combat practitioners who spend thousands on armor and swords, love medieval treatises (Talhoffer, Fiore), and want to track their training or display their gear.
product_angles: 3D printable wall mounts for specific feder/longsword types on Cults3D
KDP Sparring & Tournament Logbook with historical manuscript illustrations on the cover
SVG/Vector vectorization of high-quality medieval combat treaty poses for t-shirts and stickers
proposals.first_test_product: A minimalist KDP training journal for Longsword practitioners with custom technique-tracking pages.

proposals.name: Amateur Radio (HAM Radio) & SWL Operators
proposals.buyer_persona: Tech-savvy, often older hobbyists with disposable income who build their own antennas, communicate globally, and obsess over signal logs and specialized station gear.
product_angles: KDP QSL Contact Logbooks with vintage patent art or technical schematics on the cover
3D printable custom enclosures for popular micro-transceivers (e.g., uSDX, QRP Labs) on Cults3D
Redbubble schematic-art posters and humor stickers using insider codes (Q-codes, 73, 88)
proposals.first_test_product: A premium amateur radio logbook designed for field operations (POTA/SOTA activations).

proposals.name: Godot Engine Solo Game Developers
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie developers migrating from Unity/Unreal to Godot, looking for rapid prototyping UI assets, pixel-art tilesets, or procedural shaders that fit Godot's node system.
product_angles: Retro-futuristic Sci-Fi UI/UX Vector Asset Pack (SVG & PNG slices optimized for Godot Control nodes)
Pack of 50 seamless low-poly retro-textures (PS1 style) generated via AI image workflow + upscaler
3D low-poly environment assets in GLTF format ready to import
proposals.first_test_product: A cyberpunk UI kit containing buttons, panels, progress bars, and icons optimized for Godot 4.x.

proposals.name: Pediatric Occupational Therapists (Ergothérapeutes)
proposals.buyer_persona: Dedicated pediatric therapists and special education teachers looking for fine-motor control worksheets, sensory diet trackers, and visual schedules for neurodivergent children.
product_angles: Printable PDF scissor skills and line-tracing activity packs
3D printable adaptive pencil grips and custom textured sensory toys on Cults3D
KDP Daily Session Planner & Client Progress Tracker tailored for school-based therapists
proposals.first_test_product: A printable 50-page fine motor skills activity book featuring progressive line-tracing and shapes.

proposals.name: Speleology & Cave Exploration (Spéléologie)
proposals.buyer_persona: Hardcore outdoor explorers who map underground caves. They love technical gear, surveying, and have a strong, slightly dark sense of humor about tight spaces.
product_angles: KDP Cave Survey & Mapping field notebooks with waterproof-style cover designs
3D printable custom helmet mounts for backup flashlights or specific action cameras
Redbubble stickers featuring topographic cave maps and inside jokes ('Squeeze or Die')
proposals.first_test_product: A pocket-sized cave mapping logbook containing grid paper and survey-data tables.

proposals.name: Local French Regional Hiking Trails (GR - Grande Randonnée)
proposals.buyer_persona: French and European hikers walking iconic trails like GR20 (Corsica), GR34 (Brittany), or the Stevenson Trail (GR70). They want souvenirs, physical logs, or custom map assets.
product_angles: Unofficial KDP companion logbooks and journals for specific GR routes (with elevation profiles and stage logs)
3D printed 3D-terrain relief models of iconic mountain passes (e.g., Col du Tourmalet, GR20 segments) as desk ornaments
Minimalist SVG trail profile posters for home decor
proposals.first_test_product: An elegant, lightweight KDP hiking journal dedicated specifically to the GR34 (Sentier des Douaniers) with stage-tracking tables.
